headline: Your game folder stays up to date
intro: You can now link a game folder and let PixelDoll keep it current, while Trash gives you a safety net for deleted work. Moving around the app feels clearer too.

highlights.title: Publish exports to a project folder
highlights.text: Link a game folder from Export and PixelDoll writes your character's files into it. With Update automatically on, it refreshes after each change, and Update now checks the folder on demand.

highlights.title: Restore deleted work from Trash
highlights.text: Characters, items, categories, moves and outfits now go to Trash instead of vanishing. You can bring them back for up to 30 days, or use Undo.

highlights.title: Phaser AE export
highlights.text: The Phaser card now lets you choose Phaser AE or Phaser 3 and 4. Every export also includes guides for the engine you pick.

highlights.title: Optional music and sound effects
highlights.text: You can now turn on music and sound effects. They are off until you choose them, and the Audio control sits on every top bar.

fixes.text: Wardrobe slot icons no longer show a stray grip dot when you are not dragging.
Right-click attacks in Top-down and Side-scroller instead of opening a menu.
The Project folder card now fits on narrow phone screens.
